name: Fathom
description: A filter that breathes with the music: two filters (wah, low-pass, band-pass, high-pass, notch, vowel; in series, or in parallel and panned apart) moved by a slow envelope follower, two tempo-synced LFOs and a transient envelope that snaps or swells, with a Breathe control that adds inertia and slow drift.
author: Groundswell
